messages:
jen: Heads-up — urgent hotfix needs two approvals before the 20:15 UTC deploy cutoff. This is a small runtime mem-free bug that's causing occasional leaks in canary. Please eyeball when you can.
raj: Can you drop the PR link and a one-line summary of risk? I can take a pass in ~5.
jen: PR here: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/7890> — change is a guard around a free(), low risk, unit + integration passed locally. Patch snippet:
```diff
- free(ptr);
+ if (ptr) free(ptr);
```
samir: I'll review now. If it's only the null-check, should be quick. Ping me for quick approve. :eyes:
deploy-bot: CI: all checks passed — 12/12 green :white_check_mark: (build 7890.1)
mia: Quick question — I reproduced one OOM on staging earlier. Is that log path the same stack? If so we should validate a short stress run before full rollout.
jen: Good call — I added a minimal stress test to the PR that triggers the path. It runs fast (<2m).
raj: Reviewed. Left one tiny nit about a comment. Not blocking. LGTM after nit addressed.
samir: Skimmed the patch and stress test, looks fine. LGTM.
jen: @raj addressed the comment, thanks. We now have 2 LGTM + green CI + quick stress. Planning to merge at ~20:12 UTC and canary for 10%. If anyone sees a problem shout in next 3m.
mia: No objections from perf, monitoring looks sane. :+1:
jen: merging now and kicking canary. Will report status.
deploy-bot: Deploy started (canary) — rollout id r-2026-03-17-001, target 10% traffic
jen: Canary steady at 10% for 8m, no errors in traces. Promoting to 100% now.
deploy-bot: Deploy promoted to 100% traffic — rollout complete :rocket:
jen: Closing thread — thanks for the fast reviews everyone :tada:
